rows.t: Overlapping grants: when a student has an individual grant and is in a group with a grant for the same experiment, (a) does the group grant also cover them, and (b) if one grant is withdrawn, can they still open it through the other?

Each grant is shown with its own state; withdrawal names the grant it ends and says the other is not changed. No “can / can’t open” statement for this case; Rahul’s screens for it are not drawn (B2-13 explains which existing state each answer would use).
